Rabbids Land.name: Rabbids Land
Rabbids Land.summary: Rabbids Land is an exclusive Wii U title and the seventh installment in the Raving Rabbids franchise. The game is essentially a mini-game collection that is set around Theme Park attractions of which there are over twenty different activities including a princess castle, pirate boat, haunted house, tunnel of love, roller coaster, and many more.

Wii Party U.name: Wii Party U
Wii Party U.summary: It's time to party with Wii U Enjoy board games and mini-games on the TV, play familiar tabletop games using the Wii U GamePad Controller, or transform your living room into a game show floor. No matter what kind of party you're throwing, Wii Party U offers something for everyone.
